title: Revenue Cycle Policy Manual: Consolidation of Invoices on a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Section: Consolidation of invoices — Patient Payment Plans**

**Clause 1 (one patient per plan).** A plan consolidates invoices of one patient: every invoice on a plan belongs to the plan's own patient (the guarantor who owes the installments). An invoice of another person is never placed on the plan.

**Clause 2 (enrolled balance).** The plan's enrolled balance is the total of the balance due of the invoices enrolled at offer time.

**Clause 3 (which invoices are enrolled).** All of the patient's invoices that are eligible on the offer date are enrolled together, unless the patient names the invoices to include. The term is chosen against the total of the invoices actually enrolled.

**Clause 4 (lifetime capacity).** A plan carries at most the term's maximum number of invoices over its life (the "most invoices one plan may carry" figure of the term schedule).

**Clause 5 (no splitting).** An invoice is never split between two plans, or between a plan and the statement cycle: an invoice is either wholly on the plan or wholly off it.

## Application notes

| Situation at offer | Invoices enrolled | Total the term is chosen against |
|---|---|---|
| The patient names no invoices | Every invoice of the patient eligible on the offer date | The total balance due of all of them |
| The patient names particular invoices | The invoices the patient names | The total balance due of the named invoices |

**Hypothetical example A.** On the offer date a patient has three eligible invoices with balances due of 120.00, 95.50 and 310.00, and names none. All three are enrolled; the enrolled balance is 525.50, and the term is chosen against 525.50.

**Hypothetical example B.** The same patient names only the first two invoices. Those two are enrolled; the enrolled balance is 215.50, and the term is chosen against 215.50. The third invoice is not on the plan, and no part of it is.

**Hypothetical example C.** A patient asks for half of a 600.00 invoice to go on the plan and the other half to stay on statements. Clause 5 does not allow it: the invoice is enrolled whole or not at all.
